item.title: Boat transportation open for Tinian Hot Pepper Festival; Pika Fun Run 5K on Feb. 14
item.description: (MVA) — Boat rides from Saipan to the 22nd Annual Tinian Hot Pepper Festival in the Marianas next month are now available for booking. The post Boat transportation open for Tinian Hot Pepper Festival; Pika Fun Run 5K on Feb. 14 appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Governor discusses strategic partnership between Korea University and NMC
item.description: (Office of the Governor) — On Jan. 15, Gov. David M. Apatang hosted a high-level delegation from Korea University, led by Chairman Changduk Jung, Ph.D., to discuss a transformative partnership aimed at expanding educational opportunities and bolstering the Commonwealth’s burgeoning educational tourism sector. The post Governor discusses strategic partnership between Korea University and NMC appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Precinct 2 lawmakers spruce up Susupe government area
item.description: PRECINCT 2 Reps. John Paul P. Sablan and Danny I. item.title: 29 new US citizens sworn in
item.description: TWENTY-NINE new U.S. citizens were sworn in at a special naturalization ceremony held at the District Court for the NMI on Tuesday. The post 29 new US citizens sworn in appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Rep. Aldan: CPA solar farm could help lower airfares
item.description: THE chairman of the House Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure believes that the Commonwealth Ports Authority’s solar farm project, once completed, could translate into lower airfares that would encourage more visitors to the CNMI. The post Rep. Aldan: CPA solar farm could help lower airfares appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Defense moves to strike amended filing in Mendiola case
item.description: LIEUTENANT Gov. Dennis James C. Mendiola’s lawyer said prosecutors have disregarded “rudimentary” criminal procedure by filing a sweeping first amended information without court approval, prompting a motion asking the Superior Court to strike the filing entirely as the case moves toward a March trial. The post Defense moves to strike amended filing in Mendiola case appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: King-Hinds says current data does not support ending EVS-TAP
item.description: U.S. Congresswoman Kimberlyn King-Hinds does not believe that changes to the CNMI-Guam Visa Waiver Program or the Economic Vitality & Security–Travel Authorization Program or EVS-TAP are warranted at this time, noting that births by tourists have declined significantly. The post King-Hinds says current data does not support ending EVS-TAP appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.
